about.title: Mobile architecture and AI
about.subtitle: I’m a systems architect with over 14 years of engineering experience across mobile apps, backend services, and software delivery.
about.bioP1: Hello! I'm Eugenio Tesio, a Mobile Expert, Systems Architect, and Electronics Engineer with more than 14 years of end-to-end software delivery and hardware systems engineering.
about.latestRole: As Mobile Expert at ueno bank (ITTI), I led the migration from a Flutter monolith to independently developed micro-apps in a shared app shell. This let more than 50 engineers work in parallel. I also set up automated releases every 15 days across three app stores. During a four-month assignment on uGO, I built React Native micro-frontends integrated through Module Federation, with Playwright screenshot tests and a Storybook component catalog.
about.aiExperience: At ueno bank, I served as a champion of our spec-driven development SDLC and drove its adoption across several teams, with a written specification as the starting point for every change. I integrated it with AI agents in Cursor and GitHub Copilot to speed up architectural refactoring and align code review criteria.
about.earlierRoles: At PairTree, I developed Flutter features for an adoption platform and maintained FastAPI services with 100% test coverage. I built Flutter apps and NestJS services at Tandamos, and Spring Boot microservices on Google Cloud at Valtech.
about.bioP4: Holding a formal Electrical & Electronics Engineering degree from Universidad Tecnológica Nacional (UTN), my engineering intuition extends from serial buses (RS485 Modbus) and EV charging protocols (OCPP 1.6) to cloud microservices and modern multi-agent AI workflows.
about.quote: I look for Python and Flutter work where architecture, test coverage, and the release train are what make the product reliable.
